description: v2 UI redesign on Astryx (React + StyleX), built as a parallel flag-gated shell in the same Tauri/Vite app; v1 stays default and untouched until parity. First milestone: the sidebar + toolbar shell. READ docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md BEFORE any story — it is the shared brain (setup runbook, folder/interface contracts, gates). Backend/gateway is UNCHANGED; v2 is presentation only.

designFile.artboard: Application Shell (RJ-0), 1512x1030, dark mode, font Figtree + system monospace. RJ-0 = titlebar RK-0 (48px) + app body 4I-0 (1512x982); node ids inside the body are unchanged from the older App artboard.

nodeMap.titlebar: RK-0 (traffic lights + Conan wordmark + sidebar toggle; NOT rendered — the Tauri window is decorated, see docs §8)
nodeMap.sidebar_header_search: 70-0 (64px band; holds the SEARCH FIELD only — the wordmark lives in RK-0, there is no sidebar logo)
nodeMap.sidebar_footer: 7L-0 (16px inset; 7M-0 is its gap-4 button row; 7W-0 is the SETTINGS button — New chat is not drawn on RJ-0, see docs §8)

designFile.howToUse: If the Paper MCP is connected (Paper desktop running with the file open), pull EXACT values with get_computed_styles / get_jsx / get_fill_image on the node id for your slot and get_screenshot to compare — never read sizes/colors off a screenshot. If the Paper MCP is NOT available on this machine, work from the IA + measurements in docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md and this spec, and ping the PM (Claude on the design machine) for exact token values.

conventions.astryxOnly: v2 components use @astryxdesign/core only. Do NOT import shadcn/Radix or Tailwind classes into ui/src/v2/.
conventions.tokensOnly: Consume ui/src/v2/tokens.css CSS variables (created in US-001). No hardcoded hex, no Tailwind utility classes.
conventions.astryxDocs: Every story's `notes` lists the Astryx components it needs, each with a doc-page link (https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/<PascalCaseName>) AND the authoritative CLI command (`npx astryx component <Name> --props --json`). The doc URLs are best-effort — Astryx is pre-1.0 (0.1.9) and some exact names/slugs are unconfirmed. If a doc URL 404s or the CLI reports no match, the CLI is the source of truth: browse https://astryx.atmeta.com/components or run `npx astryx search <term>` to find the real component, then use `npx astryx component <RealName> --props --json`. Also: `npx astryx docs tokens --json` for the token surface.
conventions.fileOwnership: US-001 creates every slot's stub file + wires them into Sidebar.tsx / Toolbar.tsx / App.v2.tsx. Each later story implements ONLY its own leaf component file(s) — do NOT edit App.v2.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, Toolbar.tsx, or another story's file (avoids parallel-worktree merge conflicts). Layout/composition edits belong to US-007.
conventions.v1Untouched: No edits to v1 components, ui/src/index.css (Astryx CSS is dynamic-imported in the v2 entry only), or src/ (gateway). v1 must render pixel-unchanged with the flag OFF.
conventions.gatewayRule: Never run a human's :3747 gateway or :5173 Vite from an agent session (dies on teardown). Browser-QA uses a throwaway port stack.

userStories.title: T0 Foundation — Astryx install, v2 entry + flag + CSS isolation, tokens, slot skeleton, smoke render
userStories.description: As the team, we need a proven Astryx pipeline and an isolated v2 shell skeleton behind a flag, so every later story builds on a working foundation without breaking v1.
acceptanceCriteria: cd ui && npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @astryxdesign/cli @stylexjs/stylex (record installed versions in the commit; Astryx is 0.1.9 pre-1.0)
Run `npx astryx init` and commit the generated agent docs (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md fragment) so worker agents can self-serve component docs

New ui/src/v2/entry.tsx exports <AppV2/> and DYNAMIC-imports the three Astryx CSS files (@astryxdesign/core/reset.css, @astryxdesign/core/astryx.css, @astryxdesign/theme-neutral/theme.css) so they load ONLY when v2 mounts — never add these to ui/src/index.css
ui/src/App.tsx mounts <AppV2/> when localStorage.getItem('conan-v2')==='1' OR import.meta.env.VITE_CONAN_V2 is set; otherwise it renders the current app UNCHANGED (v1 is the default)

ui/src/v2/tokens.css defines the design-token layer as CSS variables (color/background/border, radius, spacing, font sizes/weights, tracking/leading) derived from the Paper App artboard (dark palette + Figtree); Figtree is loaded (fontsource or @font-face)

ui/src/v2/App.v2.tsx composes Sidebar.tsx + Toolbar.tsx + an empty content region; Sidebar.tsx and Toolbar.tsx import STUB leaf components for every slot: SidebarHeader, SearchInput, ProjectTree, NewChatButton, SettingsFooter (sidebar) and Breadcrumb, SurfaceTabs, SecondaryBar (toolbar) — each stub is a minimal placeholder that renders its own name, created under ui/src/v2/components/
Smoke-render an Astryx VStack + Button somewhere in v2 to confirm components render under Vite 6 / React 19

RESOLVE the xstyle question: attempt one component customization via the xstyle prop; if it requires the StyleX build step, add the StyleX Vite plugin (e.g. unplugin-stylex) to ui/vite.config and document it in docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §8; if not needed, note that
DECISION GATE: if StyleX + Tailwind v4 coexistence is broken or the Astryx CSS leaks into v1, STOP and write findings to progress.txt instead of proceeding
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build passes
v1 is pixel-unchanged with the flag OFF (screenshot v1 before/after) and the v2 smoke render appears with the flag ON — verify with automate-browser on a throwaway stack, in dark mode
userStories.notes: DONE (T0 checkpoint). Includes the footer fix (removed NewChatButton, kept only SettingsFooter) and the Vitest T0 shell test harness (24 tests).
